english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
english_translations.shakir: Surely (as for) those who persecute the believing men and the believing women, then do not repent, they shall have the chastisement of hell, and they shall have the chastisement of burning.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Those who persecute the believing men and women without repenting will suffer the torment of hell and that of the burning fire.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance, (to Allah), will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.
english_translations.arberry: Those who persecute the believers, men and women, and then have not repented, there awaits them the chastisement of Gehenna, and there awaits them the chastisement of the burning.

ayahs.transliteration: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru dhālika l-fawzu l-kabīru
ayahs.translation_bn: যারা ঈমান আনে আর সৎকাজ করে তাদের জন্য আছে জান্নাত, যার পাদদেশ দিয়ে বয়ে চলেছে নির্ঝরিণী, এটা বিরাট সাফল্য।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যারা ঈমান আনে আর সৎকাজ করে তাদের জন্য আছে জান্নাত, যার পাদদেশ দিয়ে বয়ে চলেছে নির্ঝরিণী, এটা বিরাট সাফল্য।
ayahs.meta_bn: পরম মহা সাফল্য: মুমিন ও সৎকর্মশীলদের জন্য প্রবাহমান ঝর্ণাধারার জান্নাত
ayahs.meta_en: The Ultimate Triumph: Flowing Gardens of Paradise for Verified Nodes
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ف-و-ز (f-w-z): ultimate victory, lasting equilibrium in the celestial biosphere.

english_translations.shakir: Surely (as for) those who believe and do good, they shall have gardens beneath which rivers flow, that is the great achievement.
